title: 実装ownerのRole名がRole辞書に無いと計画系が実在しない共有Assetとして解決し、guidance系Work Itemが誤った対象・過大なRisk Tierで生成される
summary: The ai-development-improvement planner (_planning.py resolve_existing_asset) treats any implementation_owner value not in the hard-coded ROLE_OWNERS set as an existing shared-asset id. Remedies recorded with implementation_owner 'consumer-project' (a consumer-side role used by research workers since 2026-08-31) were routed in run MNT-20260907T190654Z to target kind shared-existing-asset with asset_id 'consumer-project' (no such asset exists in shared-agent-plugins; path resolved to null) at risk tier R2, instead of consumer-configuration guidance at authority tier R0. Three work items (WRK-20260907T192541Z-832AB2C0/-5E10E1A7/-848B110B) were mis-scoped and required controller re-scoping. The documented invariant 'a human role in implementation_owner is never an asset' is enforced only for an enumerated word list, so any unlisted role alias silently produces a wrong target, wrong risk tier, and a release path against a nonexistent asset.

evidence.summary: ROLE_OWNERS set (lines ~25-31) lacks 'consumer-project'/'consumer'; resolve_existing_asset falls through to implementation-owner-asset and returns the role string as asset_id.
History shows initial target shared-existing-asset asset_id 'consumer-project' (nonexistent), risk R2, re-scoped by controller to consumer-configuration R0.
